issues.title: High Total Blocking Time
issues.detail: TBT is 7.61s (threshold 0.2s) — a proxy for render-blocking/heavy JavaScript.
issues.recommendation: Defer/async non-critical JS, split large bundles, and audit third-party scripts.

issues.title: Slow fully-loaded time
issues.recommendation: Review the full resource waterfall in the linked GTmetrix report for the longest-pole resource.

issues.title: Heavy total page weight
issues.recommendation: Audit the resource breakdown below for the heaviest category and target that first.

issues.title: High request count
issues.recommendation: Consolidate/lazy-load third-party embeds and Shopify apps that each add their own requests.
